title: Edit Distance
explanation: Levenshtein distance over prefixes: 25M states, so roll two rows to save memory.
traps: A 5001 × 5001 int table is ~100 MB; keep only two rows.

extraLayers.prompt: What should the DP state represent?

options.text: dp[i][j] = minimum edits to turn the first i chars of s into the first j chars of t
dp[l][r] = edits needed for substring s[l..r]
options.why: Edit distance compares prefixes of two strings, not intervals of one.

options.text: dp[i] = edits needed for the first i characters of both strings
options.why: The two prefixes can have different lengths.

options.text: dp[i][j] = length of the longest common subsequence of the prefixes
options.why: Close relative (LCS), but with replacements it doesn't give edit distance directly.

extraLayers.explanation: Two sequences → state is a pair of prefix lengths.

extraLayers.prompt: Given that state, which transition is right?

options.why: That's the LCS skip step; edit distance minimizes.
Forgets the free match / replace on the diagonal.

extraLayers.explanation: Delete s_i, insert t_j, or match/replace the last characters.
